verdict: Close to break-even: at 1.30R the target must come first in 43% of the replays that hit a side; it did in 39% (target first 34.4% vs stop first 53.3%).
plain: We replayed the trading window 5,000 times using this market's own recent price moves. The first target was reached before the safety exit in 34% of replays, the safety exit was hit first in 53%, and in 12% neither happened in time. In real history (59 past starts), the same distances hit the target first 10 times and the stop first 24 times. Overall: about a coin flip once the reward size is counted.
caveat: A simulation from recent bars, not a prediction. News, earnings and gaps can do what the last 60 days never did.
